title: Carbon footprint
description: The estimated energy and CO₂ of the models the project's agents call, with a monthly budget and an ESG export.
noData: Nothing to show yet. The report fills as the agents work on this project.
noLedger: No model call is recorded for this project yet. Builds started from now on are recorded; "Rebuild from costs" recovers the earlier ones from the cost records.
estimated: Every figure is an estimate: providers publish no energy per call. It comes from the tokens, the model's size, the data centre's PUE and the grid's carbon intensity.
unknownHosts: Where these providers run is a guess: {{providers}}.

actions.backfillHint: Rebuild the ledger from the cost records of every build of the project

errors.noProject: Select a project to see its footprint.

budget.title: Budget of {{month}}
budget.none: No monthly budget is set. Set one in the settings below to get alerts.
budget.alertAt: First alert at {{percent}}%, then at 100%, on the desktop and on your notification channel.
budget.degraded: The budget is reached and the degraded mode is on: flagship models run on their provider's standard model until the end of the month.

advice.review_on_fast: {{share}}% of the review and QA footprint comes from large models. A fast model is usually enough there and uses about {{saving}}% less energy.
advice.use_cache: Only {{share}}% of the input tokens sent to {{provider}} are read from its prompt cache. Keeping prompts stable lets the cache serve more of them.
advice.cleaner_region: {{provider}} is counted on the {{from}} grid. A region in {{to}} would emit about {{saving}}% less.
advice.local_heavier: Your local models use {{local}} Wh per 1,000 tokens written, the cloud ones {{cloud}} Wh: here the cloud is lighter.
advice.local_lighter: Your local models use {{local}} Wh per 1,000 tokens written, the cloud ones {{cloud}} Wh: here local is lighter.

export.title: ESG export of {{month}}
export.description: CSRD (ESRS E1-6: cloud models in Scope 3 category 1, local models in Scope 2 location-based) and GRI 305-3 / 302-1, with the method and the factors used.

settings.title: Carbon settings
settings.description: Kept in .workpilot/carbon.json, for this project only.
settings.regionHint: Used for local models. Cloud models are counted on their provider's grid.
settings.degrade: Degraded mode when the budget is reached
settings.degradeHint: Flagship models (Opus, GPT flagships…) step down to their provider's standard model. Standard, fast and local models stay as chosen.
settings.cpuOnly: Local models run on the CPU only
settings.cpuOnlyHint: Counts 45 W instead of the power above.
